name: tetherd
description: Keeps containers attached to the network of the container they route through, such as apps using --network container:gluetun. When the VPN container restarts, those apps stay running but go offline; Tetherd repairs that with a restart where possible, and only rebuilds when the VPN container was recreated. Clean-room successor to Rebuild-DNDC: it reads live Docker config, not Unraid XML. Stop Rebuild-DNDC before installing. Needs the Docker socket, same trade-off as Watchtower. After install, docker exec tetherd tetherd doctor. Set restart policy to Unless Stopped.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Host Docker socket. Required, same as Watchtower.

paths.name: Unraid webGui
paths.description: Unraid marker and template audit. Not used for notifications.

paths.name: Unraid notifications
paths.description: Unraid's .notify directory. Required for the notification bell. The host PHP notify script cannot run in this image.

paths.name: Docker templates
paths.description: User templates, read-only, for tetherd doctor. Tetherd never rebuilds from these files.

variables.name: Provider
variables.description: Exact name of the VPN/network-provider container (e.g. GluetunVPN). Case-sensitive; match docker ps.

variables.name: Include
variables.description: If set, only these dependents are managed. Exact names, space or comma separated.

variables.name: Exclude
variables.description: Dependents to leave alone. Exact names, space or comma separated.

variables.name: Probe provider
variables.description: Actively test that the VPN container can route. Leave false if the image already has a healthcheck (gluetun does).

variables.name: Notify URLs
variables.description: Apprise URLs (Discord, Telegram, Gotify, ntfy, …). Unraid's own bell is used when /tmp/notifications is mounted.
